Sources differ in detail: the chart draws a browner 2013 shade with a bronze star (a shade of the same claret, the same crest at 64 px), and some files of 2014-2015 copied from en.wikipedia (he, bs) draw the crest without the star; followed the club's tr.wikipedia article (a star from 2000).
